news.title: Could WoW Forever’s Day/Night Cycle Be Getting a Change?
news.description: WoW Forever players have raised concerns about the game's 24-hour day/night cycle, with some barely getting to experience daylight in-game. Blizzard has now addressed the complaints, revealing a potential solution for Oceanic players and asking the community whether regional time zones are the answer.
